purpose: Prevent post-hoc benchmark gaming and make competitive AI superiority claims reproducible, pre-registered, statistically governed, cross-plane, and independently promotable.

preregistration.restart_rule: Any material change to baseline, workload, metric direction, practical-effect threshold, exclusion rule, statistical method, resource budget, or stopping rule invalidates the run and requires a fresh preregistration.

anti_gaming_rules: Primary outcomes cannot be changed after challenger results are visible.
Failed slices cannot be removed unless the preregistered invalid-run rule applies.
A weaker replacement baseline cannot be substituted after a study begins.
Correlated variants of one metric cannot be counted as independent dominance wins.
Aggregate wins cannot hide a declared critical-slice hard-gate failure.
Median-only latency wins cannot establish serving superiority when tail or saturation behavior is declared.
Generator self-grading cannot be the sole promotion authority.
Negative, neutral, and adverse outcomes remain in the evidence bundle.

decision_rule.primary_outcome: The preregistered uncertainty interval must satisfy the declared win or strict non-inferiority rule.
decision_rule.dominance_targets: At least three preregistered, materially distinct target dimensions must satisfy their declared practical-effect thresholds.
decision_rule.preserved_properties: Every applicable non-compensable property must pass and every protected secondary metric must satisfy its preregistered non-inferiority margin.
decision_rule.tails_and_saturation: Serving, latency, reliability, and scale claims must include the declared tail and saturation regions.
decision_rule.multiplicity: When many metrics or slices can generate a favorable conclusion, the preregistration must define multiplicity control or a hierarchical decision procedure.
decision_rule.evidence_retention: Raw results, invalid runs, exclusions, failures, and negative findings remain traceable to the final verdict.

transitions: planned -> implemented requires exact-head implementation plus focused correctness evidence
implemented -> hardened requires adversarial, concurrency, saturation, and recovery evidence
hardened -> benchmark_preregistered requires a frozen comparison protocol
benchmark_preregistered -> evaluation_complete requires execution of the frozen protocol without undeclared material changes
evaluation_complete -> independently_verified requires independent inspection of raw results, exclusions, and identity bindings
independently_verified -> superior requires the family stage-10 decision rule to pass
superior -> stale occurs on material source, model/provider, policy, dataset/workload, scorer, environment, budget, or operating-envelope drift
stale -> superior requires a fresh preregistration and full requalification
superior or stale -> demoted occurs when new evidence violates a hard gate or invalidates the previous claim

cross_family_journeys.title: Reasoning + long-context + retrieval truth
must_prove: deep evidence remains retrievable and attributable
untrusted context cannot become policy
unsupported synthesis is detected
benchmark provenance is reconstructable

cross_family_journeys.title: Memory + privacy + tenant lifecycle
must_prove: scoped memory survives restart
correction and deletion propagate
cross-user and cross-tenant retrieval remains zero
audit and lifecycle evidence are complete

cross_family_journeys.title: Agent + tool + planning transaction
must_prove: delegation remains authority-subsetted
tool side effects are idempotent or compensatable
mid-plan crash resumes from durable state
terminal completion leaves no orphan privileged work

cross_family_journeys.title: Coding + safety + independent verification
must_prove: impact analysis constrains the patch
policy remains independent of generated code
negative and regression tests execute
generator cannot self-promote its patch

cross_family_journeys.title: Multimodal + realtime untrusted-input
must_prove: embedded untrusted instructions remain untrusted
barge-in and cancellation preserve state
malformed media fails within bounds
cross-modal provenance survives streaming

cross_family_journeys.title: Routing + serving + scale degradation
must_prove: provider or device loss triggers bounded fallback
fallback preserves privacy and residency
tail latency remains within the degraded envelope
load shedding precedes uncontrolled resource growth

cross_family_journeys.title: Learning + safety + rollback
must_prove: learning yields candidates rather than direct production mutation
poisoned feedback is rejected or quarantined
promotion is independently evidenced
regression triggers deterministic rollback or demotion

cross_family_journeys.title: Scientific verification + provenance
must_prove: claims use executable or formal checks where applicable
units and numerical stability are checked
counterexamples are retained
uncertainty and verifier identity are explicit
